## 1. Content generator
Runs **every Friday 10:00** (Malaysia time) and writes **next week's** drafts to the **posts** tab with status **needs approval**.

- One post per day in `POST_DAYS` × each language in `LANGUAGES` (default 3 × EN + 中文 = 6 drafts).
- Pitches rotate weekly: profit by product / cash stuck in stock / supplier invoice mistakes.
- The call to action and WhatsApp link are added by code, with the pitch code for tracking.
- **Nothing is published here.** Change a row's status to `approved` to let workflow 2 post it.

Test: set `USE_FAKE_LLM` = TRUE in the config tab and click **Test workflow**.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.notes: Paste your Google Sheet ID here (the long part of the sheet URL between /d/ and /edit). All other settings are in the sheet's "config" tab.

nodes.name: Fetch brand rules
nodes.notes: Downloads the file at BRAND_RULES_URL (config tab). If it fails, the next node decides what to do.

nodes.name: Fetch content brief
nodes.notes: Downloads the file at CONTENT_BRIEF_URL (config tab). If it fails, the next node decides what to do.

nodes.name: Call LLM
nodes.notes: OpenAI-compatible POST {LLM_BASE_URL}/chat/completions. Credential: Header Auth, name "Authorization", value "Bearer <your key>".
